title: Lunar tidal detection in GFZ clock products (independent analysis centre)
interpretation: IGS final products (clk_gfz): 49 stations, 90 days, residual std median=5.661 ns.
M2 (lunar): mean amp=0.2290 ns, median amp=0.0843 ns.
S2 (solar): mean amp=2.7675 ns, median amp=1.3296 ns.
S2 phase prediction: r=0.9348269963389775, p=0.0, n_pairs=1176.
caveats: IGS products at 300s cadence (vs 30s for RTKLIB PPP).
No station has all 90 days; using best available window.
IGS global network adjustment removes common-mode signals.
pre_registered_prediction: If the lunar tides in RTKLIB PPP are a real gravitational signal, they should also appear (at reduced amplitude) in IGS products with phase coherence across stations. If they are a processing artefact, they should NOT be phase-coherent in IGS products.
